title: Rootlings momentum grows with new State Champions
summary: Momentum for Australia’s network of young grape and wine professionals, Rootlings, continues to grow as its latest state champions are announced.

title: More Australians are exploring wine through experiences, events and discovery
summary: Australians are increasingly seeking experiences that bring together food, connection and discovery, and local wine is uniquely placed to be part of those moments.

title: Australian wine exports decline in line with global wine consumption
summary: Australian wine exports declined by 7 per cent in value to $2.30 billion and 6 per cent in volume to 598 million litres in the year ended June 2026, according to Wine Australia’s Export Report released today.

title: Wine Australia and Vinehealth Australia collaborate for stronger vineyard data
summary: Wine Australia and Vinehealth Australia are co-investing to modernise South Australia’s Vinehealth Vineyard Register and align it with the National Vineyard Register.

title: Smallest vintage in 25 years reflects market pressures and seasonal conditions
summary: Australia’s 2026 winegrape crush fell to 1.27 million tonnes – its smallest since 2000 – but the reduced national crop did not result in stronger grape prices according to Wine Australia’sNational Vintage Report 2026released today.

title: Novel cold stabilisation solution undergoes evaluation
summary: An innovative cold stabilisation method that could significantly reduce processing times, lower energy consumption and eliminate the need for single-use additives is being evaluated under local conditions in a new Wine Australia supported project.

title: Next Crop 2026 programs kick off in Hunter Valley, McLaren Vale and Riverland
summary: Wine Australia's 2026 Next Crop programs are underway in the Hunter Valley, McLaren Vale and Riverland, bringing together each region’s emerging leaders to build the skills, networks and confidence needed to navigate the rapidly changing wine sector.

title: Inspiring the next generation to embark on careers in wine
summary: Continuing its ongoing efforts to promote the many career pathways in the grape and wine sector to the next generation, Wine Australia recently connected with students at two Adelaide high schools through two career-focused activations

title: Disease-resistant vines to take root in Sydney high school vineyard
summary: A modest, redeveloped vineyard at a high school in Sydney’s Northern Beaches will soon be an unlikely home to disease-resistant grapevines that have been developed by CSIRO, Australia’s national science agency, in a long-running breeding program supported by Wine Australia.

title: Project explores new pathway to making reduced-alcohol wine
summary: The potential of a novel processing approach to deliver reduced-alcohol wines without compromising quality is being explored as part of project being led by Australia’s national science agency CSIRO.
